name: Nox
overview: A dark Jellyfin theme with a floating, expandable navigation rail, a gold accent and fully themed login and setup screens.
description: Nox retints Jellyfin Web from a single token layer: near-black page, a raised surface for cards and dialogs, muted blue-grey secondary text, an accent driven by one custom property, rounded posters with a hover shadow, gradient-scrimmed heroes, and restrained motion. Above 1100px the top bar becomes a floating black pill rail on the left whose buttons show their icon over a localised label, expanding on hover or keyboard focus; below that width it falls back to a themed top bar. Covers home, detail pages, the player OSD, dialogs, forms, the login screen and the first-run wizard. Includes a bridge to Jellyfin's --jf-palette-* variables plus fourteen alternate palettes.
changelog: 0.1.3: documentation and delivery. The README now pins the install line to a release tag instead of `@main`, because jsDelivr caches a branch ref for up to twelve hours and can serve an older build of `nox.css` with no error: the theme applies, the palette changes, and the header silently keeps the old layout. Adds the stale-CDN-copy check to the troubleshooting section and a commit-pinned import line for installations that must never change. No rules changed. 0.1.2: fixed the navigation rail silently reverting to the stock top bar. Jellyfin wraps both header button groups in an intermediate `.headerTop` element that the theme did not account for, which collapsed `.headerLeft` to zero width, and Jellyfin's own `.skinHeader` rule has the same specificity as the theme's, so stylesheet load order decided the header's position and size. Every header rule is now written `body .skinHeader ...`, which wins on specificity instead of on order, and `.headerTop` is re-laid-out as the rail's column. Also: header buttons no longer depend on the `paper-icon-button-light` element upgrade for a transparent background, the rail scrolls rather than clipping on short screens, localised labels truncate instead of overflowing, the sub-1100px top bar takes the accent on its leading entry, and nox.min.css is rebuilt. 0.1.1: replaced the top bar with an expandable pill navigation rail (icon over localised label, expands on hover and focus, actions anchored to the bottom); retuned the palette to a warm near-black page with a gold accent; rebuilt the hero with a scrimmed backdrop and a cut-out action plaque; extended coverage to the login screen and first-run setup; fixed three light palettes whose accent fill failed AA contrast for button labels; documented every !important; collected all fragile selectors into one BRITTLE section. 0.1.0: initial release.
author: Nox contributors

accent.note: Change this one property to re-skin every accent surface. Pair it with --nox-accent-rgb, the same colour as a triplet, which tinted states use.
